evidence: The dispatch fixes the speaker: 'Speaker is g20 leftover-join.v8.' These two leaves name g20 leftover-join.v7 in the agent position of a present-tense verb, 'consumes'.

This is a regression against the subject's own convention, established leaf by leaf. Of the 24 basedOn role leaves, every other leaf that takes a speaker position names the speaker: occupancyV2.role 'g20 leftover-join.v8 does not occupy the identifier', d298.role 'g20 leftover-join.v8 does not remasure occupancy v2', d322.role 'g20 leftover-join.v8 does not remasure G19', sdkJoinV6.role 'g20 leftover-join.v8 does not steal those leftovers', d056.role 'g20 leftover-join.v8 is not a SATISFIED-GRADE cycle'. Only namedCatalog.role and inputCorpus.role name v7.

The version history shows these two leaves are speaker-position leaves that each successor is expected to re-point, not historical recitals. In g20 leftover-join.v3, v4, v5 and v6 both leaves read 'This join consumes that naming.' Frozen g20 leftover-join.v7 repaired the deictic by writing its own name into exactly these two leaves — 'g20 leftover-join.v7 consumes that naming' — which was correct at v7. A leaf-level diff of v7 against the subject shows both leaves carried over byte-identical while 20 other prose leaves had their speaker token advanced to v8.

Neither leaf is marked as historical. The subject's genuinely historical leaves are framed as such — predecessorV3.role, predecessorV5.role and predecessorV6.role each open 'Predecessor. Unmoved.' and close 'Not this artifact's version number.', and sdkJoinV4.role and sdkJoinV5.role are marked 'Historical.' These two leaves carry no such framing; their subject is the live input and the sentence states who presently consumes it.

The trailing pronoun compounds the defect. 'It does not close OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING.' and 'It does not close leftover-design of fixture implementations.' now take v7 as antecedent, so the subject nowhere states, in either leaf, that the speaker itself consumes those namings or that the speaker's consumption closes nothing.

The two leaves are load-bearing for the candidate's measurement. obligations[OBL-G20-NAMED-CATALOG].leftoverDesign and obligations[OBL-G20-INPUT-CORPUS].leftoverDesign are both false, and the stated reason in each case is that the naming exists and is consumed. The basedOn leaf that records that consumption attributes it to a document the same artifact expressly calls 'Unrecorded' and 'Not this artifact's version number.'

The candidate is chartered on precisely this defect class. purpose and authorityClaim both state that g20 leftover-join.v8 lands the v7 Stage A Codex unlabeled SHOULD-FIX and Claude ADV-1, both of which are speaker- and lineage-custody repairs in basedOn role leaves. findingDisposition.claudeV7ADV1 records 'Landed: basedOn.sdkJoinV6.role names g20 leftover-join.v8.' One speaker leaf was re-pointed while two others were left pointing at the superseded predecessor.

Read alone, basedOn.namedCatalog.role and basedOn.inputCorpus.role assert that an unrecorded frozen predecessor is the present consumer of the two live namings, and deny closure on that predecessor's behalf rather than the speaker's. If g20 leftover-join.v8 is adopted as the current G20 leftover remasurement, the recorded artifact's own basis block will credit v7 with consuming the namings that support two of the speaker's four leftoverDesign-false measurements, and will never say the speaker does.

verdictStatement: REJECT at 0 MUST-FIX and 1 SHOULD-FIX. g20 leftover-join.v8 is a clean successor on every measured axis but one. Subject custody is intact: live sha256 equals e29e0fa1…, mode 0444, unmoved at open and at write, and frozen g20 leftover-join.v7 is likewise unmoved. All 42 cited path/digest pairs match live bytes, all 8 cited commits resolve as ancestors of live HEAD with matching subjects, and every cited review verdict was checked against the live review file rather than accepted. The candidate lands the g20 leftover-join.v7 Stage A Codex unlabeled SHOULD-FIX in full — all five bare G20 tokens across four leaves are stemmed — and lands Claude ADV-1, replacing the last 'This GATE leftover-join' deictic with the speaker's name. Zero banned deictic forms and zero unstemmed leftover-join.vN tokens survive anywhere in 306 string leaves.
